description: 8.1.3. A count is a rate: consumed on attempt and never released, including on failure. Releasing it would let an agent with a total failure rate retry without bound, which is the case the control exists for. The amount from the same payments does come back (8.1.4), so this vector separates the two dimensions rather than assuming they move together.
